intent: Check catalog for Heco wood screw 6mm in Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ line
success_criteria: SQL returns matching product_variant row or empty
If found, refs contain the matched product record_path

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pt ON pt.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pt.property_key = 'screw_type' JOIN product_variant_properties pd ON pd.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND pd.property_key = 'diameter_mm' WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.series = :series AND pv.model = :model AND pt.property_value_text = :screw_type AND pd.property_value_number = :diameter_mm;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products.

answer_template.message: <YES> Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ wood screw 6mm in catalogue at $path. / <NO> Not in catalogue.
